problem: What is the dimension of ${R}_{20}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $20?$
worked_solution:
The standard basis of ${R}_{n}[t]$ is

$$
{1,\,t,\,{t}^{2},\,…,\,{t}^{n}}.
$$

So, the standard basis of ${R}_{20}[t]$ is 

$$
{1,\,t,\,{t}^{2},\,…,\,{t}^{20}}.
$$

Therefore, we have that 

$$
\text{dim}({R}_{20}[t])=20+1=21.
$$

In general,

$$
\text{dim}({R}_{n}[t])=n+1.
$$
